claims.text: Using the accepted LR presentation of \(Q=J_v/\Lambda_+J_v\), a right-to-left row-reading LR-tableau enumerator and integral SNF calculation returned torsion-free quotients \(Q\cong\mathbb Z^d\) for all 90 rectangular instances in \(\{r\le5,q=n-r\le6\}\setminus\{r\le4,q\le5\}\). In each row below, entries are \(d\), with columns \(i=1,\ldots,q-1\) and rows \(j=1,\ldots,r-1\): \[ \begin{array}{c|c|c} (r,q)&j& (d_i)_i\\ \hline (2,6)&1&(2,2,2,2,2)\\ \hline (3,6)&1&(3,3,3,3,2)\\ &2&(2,3,3,3,3)\\ \hline (4,6)&1&(4,4,4,3,2)\\ &2&(3,6,6,6,3)\\ &3&(2,3,4,4,4)\\ \hline (5,2)&1,2,3,4&(2)\\ \hline (5,3)&1&(3,2)\\ &2&(3,3)\\ &3&(3,3)\\ &4&(2,3)\\ \hline (5,4)&1&(4,3,2)\\ &2&(4,6,3)\\ &3&(3,6,4)\\ &4&(2,3,4)\\ \hline (5,5)&1&(5,4,3,2)\\ &2&(4,10,6,3)\\ &3&(3,6,10,4)\\ &4&(2,3,4,5)\\ \hline (5,6)&1&(5,5,4,3,2)\\ &2&(4,10,10,6,3)\\ &3&(3,6,10,10,4)\\ &4&(2,3,4,5,5) \end{array} \] Every displayed \(d\) equals \[ \binom{\min(q-i,r-j)+\min(i,j)}{\min(q-i,r-j)}. \] [artifact ce9dca58d3924029b4839d830f43cfe6514239f9a1025dc2f51a2e1c9bb3fedb]

For any tabulated instance, the accepted \(N=d\)-element Schur generating families are irredundant: their images span \(Q\cong\mathbb Z^N\), whereas \(N-1\) elements cannot span \(\mathbb Z^N\); graded Nakayama then implies that no generator can be deleted.

The retained sandbox artifact does not document a second independently implemented LR/SNF computation, nor Pieri-based verification of all 90 SNF outputs. Thus the requested independent reproduction of every finite result remains unverified.
